name: Leaf River Energy Center Header Pipeline

values.PipelineName: Leaf River Energy Center Header Pipeline
values.StartLocation: New Home Salt Dome storage facility, Smith County

researcher_notes: A 2008 Federal Register notice of the FERC certificate application lists the header: 6.6 miles of dual bidirectional 24-inch pipe (Dome Lateral), 6.9 miles of single 24-inch pipe west of the junction, and 30.2 miles of dual 24-inch pipe to the east. That adds to about 43.7 route miles, with interconnects to five interstate pipelines. The 2007 notice says about 43 miles through Smith, Jasper and Clarke Counties. FERC issued the certificate in Docket CP08-8 in 2008. Federal Register notices from 2023 and 2025 call the header system existing, so status is operating. The as-built length and in-service date were not found, and 43.7 is the authorized figure. No row for this header exists in the sheet. Gulf South Southeast Expansion (P5926) is a separate pipeline whose corridor the east leg follows. Owner is Leaf River Energy Center LLC. A search summary says NJR Pipeline Company, a New Jersey Resources subsidiary, bought it in October 2019. No page for that was opened, so no parent is staged. No official route data was found, so there is no route. Tier medium because every source is a federal notice from the same FERC docket.
